seo.title: By invitation — TripAgent
seo.description: TripAgent membership is by invitation. If someone has given you a key, enter it. The door opens.

step1.lede: Membership is offered in person, never sold. If someone has given you a key, enter it below.
step1.scarcity: A small number of places open each season.

requestForm.introText: Leave your details. If a place opens, your advisor reaches out — discreetly, never a mailing list.

fields.labelHtml: Tell us about your travel plans (optional)
fields.placeholder: Where you'd like to go, or who referred you

step1.requestThanks: Thank you — your request is with us. If a place opens, your advisor will be in touch, discreetly.

step2.headingHtml:
Your invitation carries
—, as our guest.
step2.lede: Your membership begins now, with our compliments.

step3.headingHtml:
So your advisor knows you
before you speak.

fields.name: phone
fields.sub: This is where your advisor reaches you.

step4.headingHtml:
So nothing interrupts you,
when the time comes.
step4.chargeLineTemplate: Nothing is charged until —. Add a card now or later — your membership is active either way.
step4.chargeNote: Cancel any time before then — a single message to your advisor, nothing to explain.

step5.defaultAdvisorLine: Your advisor will be in touch within the hour.
step5.signature: Until you are home. We stay.
